name: Luuk van der Meer
bio:
Luuk's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. This passion led him to pursue a career in automotive painting, specializing in custom designs and performance finishes. After honing his skills at a local body shop, he was recruited by Ipiranga Racing for his expertise in applying complex liveries and aerodynamic coatings.

At Ipiranga, Luuk is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to translate design concepts into flawless real-world applications. He's constantly researching new paint technologies and application techniques to improve the visual appeal and aerodynamic efficiency of the team's cars. His visionary approach helps the team stay ahead of the curve, ensuring their cars not only perform well but also make a statement on the track.

Luuk is also dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality and durability. He understands that the paint job is not just about aesthetics; it's also about protecting the car's bodywork and contributing to its overall performance. This commitment to excellence has earned him the respect of his colleagues and made him a valuable asset to Ipiranga Racing.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed, with a slight side part
physical.description: Luuk is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when no machines are running.
Insists on using only natural light when mixing custom paint colors.
Has a collection of miniature model cars on his workbench, each with a unique paint scheme.
